findings.value_description: Five ingestion handlers label host-local logging timestamps with a fixed UTC Z suffix
evidence: logging datefmt is %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ but logging.Formatter.converter is not overridden; root read-only probe observed local15:44:16Z versus UTC10:14:16. This affects log labels, not proof of corrupt generated_at snapshots.
findings.provenance: A fixed logging-format default mislabels host-local time on Windows/Asia-Kolkata; Lambda hosts commonly UTC but portability is not guaranteed.
findings.recommendation: Set an explicit UTC logging converter or include an accurate offset; preserve captured dataset bytes.
findings.author: MeenalSinha
findings.attribution_evidence: Original ingestion handler declarations; identities are Git author metadata only.
